doc: The same gaussian on a float32 2-D array: the whole expression is float32 (weak scalars), a float32 exp. Default tolerance 1e-5/1e-6: measured worst difference against float64 1e-7 (a float32 exp is within 1-2 ulp, and the argument carries a float32 rounding that exp amplifies by |2 arg|); +-1e3 underflows to 0 in float32 too.
